subject: Partner credit pass-through request — CloudKite onboarding (proposal)
messages:
From: Emma Holt <emma@cloudkite.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner credit pass-through request — CloudKite onboarding

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're rolling a cohort of 120 PLG signups that came through our integration (CloudKite <> Redwood) and we want to offer a small onboarding credit to convert signal into usage. Proposed program:

- 120 users, each eligible for $50 Redwood credit (total $6,000)
- Credits should be issued as redeemable voucher codes that users can apply to self-serve accounts
- Credits active for 90 days from issuance

Attached is our onboarding request and a short batch list for the initial cohort (CK_ONBOARDING_REQ.pdf).

Questions for you:
1) Does Redwood allow partner-issued vouchers that we can bulk upload to the marketplace?
2) If Redwood needs to issue the credits on our behalf, what approvals are required from Sales Ops / Finance?
3) Any limits on per-account credit amounts or promo stacking with existing PLG credits?

If this is simple we can start with a small pilot (25 codes) to validate redemption flow.

Best,
Emma Holt
Partnerships, CloudKite

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Partner credit pass-through request — CloudKite onboarding

Thanks Emma — good to hear. High level: we can support both models (partner uploads voucher list to marketplace OR Redwood issues codes and hands them back to you). Implementation details differ:

- Partner-upload (marketplace SKU): fastest if CloudKite can add a marketplace SKU that auto-funds credits. Ops will reconcile billing through the marketplace.
- Redwood-issued vouchers: requires approvals from Sales Ops and Finance for promotional spend; we can issue codes from a dedicated partner pool and provide a CSV of codes for you to distribute.

Marissa / Jonas / Ben — can we get Sales Ops / Finance OK for a $6k pilot? If we prefer conservative rollout, Emma suggested starting with 25 codes (~$1,250). Either way we need:

1) Approval of spend and expiry policy (90 days suggested)
2) Template SLA / T&Cs for partner-issued credits (see attached draft: partner_credit_sla.docx)
3) A reconciliation method (marketplace invoice or partner reimbursement)

Emma — please confirm pilot size and whether you prefer us to generate the codes or if you'll run via the marketplace listing. If you want Redwood to issue, we'll provide a CSV and a short redemption flow doc.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Partner Revenue — Redwood Inference
